args.query: The L1 norm of a finitely supported function is the sum of norms of its values

items.name: lp.norm_eq_tsum_rpow
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)],
  0 < p.toReal → ∀ (f : ↥(lp E p)), ‖f‖ = (∑' (i : α), ‖↑f i‖ ^ p.toReal) ^ (1 / p.toReal)

items.name: PiLp.nnnorm_eq_of_L1
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] (x : PiLp 1 β),
  ‖x‖₊ = ∑ i, ‖x.ofLp i‖₊

items.name: lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)],
  0 < p.toReal → ∀ (f : ↥(lp E p)), ‖f‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑' (i : α), ‖↑f i‖ ^ p.toReal

items.name: lp.instNormSubtypePreLpMemAddSubgroup
items.type: {α : Type u_3} → {E : α → Type u_4} → {p : ENNReal} → [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] → Norm ↥(lp E p)

items.name: MeasureTheory.L1.norm_eq_integral_norm
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {H : Type u_6} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H]
  (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp H 1 μ)), ‖f‖ = ∫ (a : α), ‖↑↑f a‖ ∂μ

items.name: WithLp.prod_norm_eq_of_L1
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup β]
  (x : WithLp 1 (α × β)), ‖x‖ = ‖x.fst‖ + ‖x.snd‖

items.name: MeasureTheory.L1.SimpleFunc.norm_eq_integral
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc E 1 μ)),
  ‖f‖ =
    MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.integral μ (MeasureTheory.SimpleFunc.map norm (MeasureTheory.Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc f))
